raw_comment:
1. I notice that though not all palces in the United States are in extreme drought, a massive part of the United States are abnormally dry. 
2. I wonder half of New York, Colorado and all of Florida are not experiencing drought.
3. This relates to my community because I know that myself and others in my community use a lot of water on a daily usage. This can affect droughts to happen. Also, if droughts happen, it affects everyone in the community. 
4. "Everyone should to help the US end this drought."
